commits.title: Buy facts: what only an owner sets about buying, in one cached read per store and market

changes.how: Server-only module ('import "server-only"'). Imports: cacheLife and cacheTag from 'next/cache', db from '@/db/client', sql from 'drizzle-orm', z from 'zod', col and typedRow from './typed-rows', refreshTag from './refresh', catalogTag from './catalog' (or from the tag leaf if step 2.20 or 2.24 made one: rg -n 'export const catalogTag' src). Exports: (1) export const BUY_PLATFORM_TAG = 'buy-platform'; export const buyTag = (storeId: string) => 'buy:' + storeId; (2) export type BuyFacts = { checkoutUi: 'custom' | 'hosted'; paymentsRow: boolean; activeMode: 'test' | 'live' | null; onMollie: boolean; starter: boolean; accountId: string | null; klarnaOff: boolean; klarnaActive: boolean; checkoutFields: boolean; quoteMode: string; backInStock: boolean; hasBreaks: boolean; hasSchemes: boolean }; (3) export async function buyFacts(storeId: string, marketCode: string): Promise<BuyFacts> whose first three lines are 'use cache'; cacheLife('hours'); cacheTag(buyTag(storeId), catalogTag(storeId), BUY_PLATFORM_TAG). One statement through typedRow with a zod row described with col (bool, text and nullable text). Copy each expression from the reader it replaces, word for word, with the store id as ${storeId}::uuid: checkout_ui from 'select checkout_ui from commerce.platform_settings' (connect.ts getCheckoutUi; 'hosted' only when the value is 'hosted', else 'custom'); payments_on, active_mode, on_mollie and starter exactly as the four expressions of getCheckoutInfo() in src/server/orders.ts (lines 523 to 547); account_id as getCheckoutAccount() in src/server/settings.ts reads it (the stripe_accounts row of the active mode with card_payments = 'active', null otherwise); klarna_off: exists (select 1 from commerce.payment_methods where store_id = the store and market_code = ${marketCode} and method = 'klarna' and not enabled); klarna_active: coalesce((select a.method_states -> 'klarna_payments' ->> 'status' = 'active' from commerce.stripe_accounts a join commerce.payment_providers p on p.store_id = a.store_id and p.provider = 'stripe' and a.mode = p.active_mode where a.store_id = the store), false); checkout_fields: exists (select 1 from commerce.checkout_fields where store_id = the store and enabled); quote_mode: coalesce((select quote_requests from commerce.order_settings where store_id = the store), 'off'); back_in_stock: the exists form of backInStockOn()'s statement in src/server/stock-requests.ts (lines 80 to 84), unchanged; has_breaks: exists (select 1 from commerce.price_breaks where store_id = the store) or exists (select 1 from commerce.price_list_breaks where store_id = the store) (open src/db/schema.ts first and confirm both tables have store_id; if price_list_breaks has none, join it to its price list); has_schemes: exists (select 1 from commerce.product_schemes where store_id = the store) (same check). The function returns the row mapped to BuyFacts and nothing computed from the environment. (4) export function refreshBuyFacts(storeId: string): void { refreshTag(buyTag(storeId)); } and export function refreshBuyPlatform(): void { refreshTag(BUY_PLATFORM_TAG); }. (5) Pure helpers that apply the environment after the read, never cached: export function paymentsOnOf(f: BuyFacts): boolean, the same formula as orders.ts lines 553 to 556 with platformModes() and mollieAppOn() imported from where orders.ts imports them; export function providerOf(f: BuyFacts): 'mollie' | 'stripe' as orders.ts line 558. Header comment: what is in it, that the product page reads it with its cached reads so it is part of the prerendered page (Next's use-cache guide: an in-memory entry does not persist between serverless requests), and that a writer of one of its tables calls refreshBuyFacts() (buy-writers.scan.test.ts).

Integration test in the style of src/server/express-checkout.int.test.ts (copy its store fixture and its mocks of next/cache and next/headers). For one fixture store and market 'NO': (a) buyFacts() agrees with the readers it replaces: checkoutUi equals getCheckoutUi(); paymentsOnOf(facts) equals (await getCheckoutInfo(storeId, 'NO')).paymentsOn and providerOf(facts) equals its provider; accountId equals (await getCheckoutAccount(storeId))?.accountId ?? null; checkoutFields equals (await listCheckoutFields(db(), storeId, { onlyOn: true })).length > 0; quoteMode equals await quoteMode(storeId); backInStock equals await backInStockOn(storeId). (b) Each fact flips after its write: switch Klarna off for NO with saveMethodChoices (klarnaOff true); add an enabled checkout field; set quote_requests; enable the back_in_stock automation; insert a price break; insert a product scheme. After each write call buyFacts() again (next/cache is mocked, so it reads again) and expect the fact changed and the old reader still agrees.
